t:type.name: DriverSummary
t:type.t:description: A device driver the platform has loaded.

t:attribute.name: name
t:attribute.description: The driver's name, as in devadv:drivername and the driverName of devadv:UpgradeDriver.

t:attribute.name: version
t:attribute.description: The driver's version, as in devadv:driverversion and the driverVersion of devadv:UpgradeDriver.

t:attribute.name: hash
t:attribute.description: Hash of the driver's source, as in devadv:driverhash.

t:attribute.name: populations
t:attribute.description: The populations this driver can be picked for. Empty for a retired driver that is kept only for devices already using it.

t:attribute.name: capabilities
t:attribute.description: Namespaces of the capabilities the driver supports.

t:attribute.name: matchers
t:attribute.description: The driver's matcher lines. A device matches the driver when it matches any line. Empty for drivers that are never picked by matching, such as the fallback driver.
